description: Fix three gaps discovered during FADE testing: missing prompt.md in init, no README, and non-directive fade run prompt
problemStatement: FADE has three usability issues: (1) fade init doesn't copy prompt.md to target projects, so Claude doesn't know the execution protocol; (2) no README.md means developers don't know how to install or use FADE; (3) fade run's injected prompt doesn't tell Claude to start executing, so Claude just asks 'what would you like help with?' instead of reading prd.json and starting work.

userStories.title: fade init copies prompt.md
userStories.description: As a developer, I want fade init to also create prompt.md so that Claude Code knows the FADE execution protocol when I run fade run.
acceptanceCriteria: Running fade init creates prompt.md in addition to FADE.md, progress.md, learned.md
prompt.md contains the full FADE execution instructions (session start, rules, exit protocol)
Running fade init when prompt.md exists doesn't overwrite it
Success message includes prompt.md in the count of created files

userStories.title: README.md with installation instructions
userStories.description: As a developer discovering FADE, I want a README.md that explains how to install and use it so I can get started quickly.
acceptanceCriteria: Includes installation instructions: adding fade to PATH via export in .zshrc
Includes usage examples for fade init and fade run
Explains what each file does: FADE.md, progress.md, learned.md, prompt.md
Includes quick start section that gets someone running in under 2 minutes

userStories.title: fade run prompt is directive
userStories.description: As a developer, I want fade run to inject a prompt that tells Claude to immediately start executing from prd.json, not ask what I want help with.
acceptanceCriteria: fade run injects a directive prompt that tells Claude to read prd.json and start the next story
Claude does not ask 'what would you like help with?' - it starts working immediately
The injected prompt references the FADE protocol and execution instructions
If prd.json doesn't exist, Claude is told to ask what the user wants to work on

technicalNotes: All fixes are to the fade bash script and adding README.md. No new dependencies.
